bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Confirm the name and BLE address for this Moonboon motor. Address: {address}.

pair_confirm.title: Pair {name}
pair_confirm.description: Press the physical pair button on the Moonboon motor at BLE address {address}. Then enable the checkbox and submit. Home Assistant will bond with the motor and read its device information before adding it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to Moonboon {address} keeps failing. Press the physical pair button, enable the checkbox, and submit to bond again.

user.title: Add Moonboon manually
user.description: Enter the BLE address shown by Home Assistant Bluetooth discovery. You will be asked to press the physical pair button on the next step.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Press the Moonboon pair button, move the Bluetooth proxy closer, then try again.
error.pair_required: Press the physical Moonboon pair button, then enable the checkbox before submitting.
error.not_found: Moonboon was not seen after entering pairing mode. Check the address and Bluetooth range, then try again.
error.pairing_unsupported: This Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy cannot initiate pairing. Update the proxy firmware or try a local adapter.
